subLocations.name: Field of Triumph
subLocations.lore:
The Field of Triumph was a large outdoor stadium.

The Field of Triumph was the venue for many public spectacles from late spring until late autumn, weather permitting. The Open Lord of Waterdeep used the Field as a public forum to give proclamations to the city.

subLocations.name: Market Hall
subLocations.lore: Market Hall was the guildhall of the [[Council of Farmer-Grocers]].

subLocations.name: Watermens' Hall
subLocations.lore: Watermens' Hall was the guildhall of the [[Guild of Watermen]].

subLocations.name: Mariners' Hall

subLocations.name: League Hall

subLocations.name: Butchers' Guildhall
subLocations.lore: The Butchers' Guildhall was the headquarters of the [[Guild of Butchers]].

subLocations.name: Cookhouse Hall
subLocations.lore: Cookhouse Hall was a civic building.

subLocations.name: Bell Tower
subLocations.lore: A municipal bell tower that was used to signal the presence of fires, attacks on the city, or call for assemblies at [[Piergeiron's Palace]].

subLocations.name: Cynosure
subLocations.lore: This former "temple of the Overgod", which had been erected in veneration of Lord Ao after the Time of Troubles, was converted into a public hall, which could be rented to use for weddings, balls and other special events.

subLocations.name: Stationers' Hall
subLocations.lore: Stationers' Hall was the guildhall of the Stationers' Guild.

subLocations.name: Jesters' Clubhouse
subLocations.lore: Jesters' Clubhouse was the guildhall of the [[Jesters' Guild]].

subLocations.name: Marching Grounds
subLocations.lore: A well protected training camp of the City Guard.

subLocations.name: Amendsfarm
subLocations.lore: A prison farm operated by the City Watch, where Waterdhavians convicted of minor offenses were sentenced to pay hard labor for a limited period of time.

subLocations.name: Muleskull Tavern
